categories_thin: Optometrists/vision: none confirmed inside the borough; the Dunellen-zip eye doctors found are on the US-22 corridor (Green Brook/North Plainfield side), which NJTGO explicitly excludes.
Veterinarians: none inside the borough; Green Brook Animal Hospital at 915 N Washington Ave and clinics on Stelton Rd are outside Dunellen proper.
Hardware store / general retail: no hardware, bike, music-instrument or appliance store found in the borough; retail is thin outside florists, nails/salons and a few gift shops.
Tutoring/test prep and driving schools: only regional/in-home services (Tutor Doctor, Club Z) serve Dunellen; no storefront in town.
Independent hotels, moving/storage, wholesale-logistics: none found in the borough; industrial uses are limited to the North Avenue Extension pocket.
caveats: Dunellen is a ~1.1 sq mi borough, so the 10-mile radius is satisfied everywhere in the zone; the list is scoped to businesses physically in the borough.
Businesses with a 'Dunellen' mailing address on US Highway 22 are frequently located in Green Brook or North Plainfield; those entries are flagged in notes.

Several directories (Yellow Pages, AllPages, Cylex, ChamberofCommerce) block direct access, so their listings were only seen as search-result summaries; entries resting on those alone are marked 'one directory only'.
Google Maps was viewed without signing in, which limits result count (~5-13 per query); a handful of low-traffic categories may still be under-covered.

Chain locations were excluded on purpose: Kessler Rehabilitation, Select Physical Therapy, World Gym, Advance Auto Parts, The UPS Store, Total Wireless, HearingLife, Jackson Hewitt, Farmers Insurance agent, and all banks/pharmacies.
data_gaps: dunellen411.com business directory is behind an Incapsula bot wall; only business names quoted in search summaries could be used.
Overpass/OpenStreetMap API did not respond within timeout; OSM was not used.

Google Maps 'limited view' without sign-in prevented paging past ~13 results per category query, so some service-area contractors (HVAC, electrical, cleaning) based in Dunellen without a storefront may be missing.
No phone/website captured for many small salons and trades where directories listed only name and address.
